title.zh: 【Threshold：tBTC 全额抵押，新存款、铸造和赎回仍处于暂停状态】
title.en: 【Threshold：tBTC 全额抵押，新存款、铸造和赎回仍处于暂停状态】

current_state.zh: Threshold Network reported that tBTC remains fully collateralized with no unauthorized minting or losses, but new deposits, minting, and redemptions are paused for cross-chain security maintenance while transfers on Ethereum and L2s continue.
